sample.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Um…where’s Sayori? Last time she was here, she had a baby bump so big she looked like she was about to pop.”

Yuri: (nervously fidgets with her book) “I…I’m not sure, Monika. I haven’t seen her since yesterday. Wasn’t she supposed to be here for the club meeting?”

Natsuki: (crosses her arms and huffs) “Knowing her, she probably forgot again. This is just like her to bail on us.”

Sayori: (enters the clubroom with a hand on her belly) “Hey guys, sorry I’m late! I overslept. Pregnancy can be tiring…and this is just my 7th month.”
sample.chosen:
Sayori: (glowing with joy as she gently pats her belly) "I apologize for causing you concern! Experiencing pregnancy feels like embarking on a brand new journey each day."

Monika: (rushing over to help Sayori to a chair) "We completely understand! Just make sure to take care of yourself. Have you been getting enough rest?"

Yuri: (setting her book aside, her nervousness replaced with genuine concern) "I... I've been reading about pregnancy wellness... if you'd like, I could share some calming tea recipes that are safe for expecting mothers."

Natsuki: (her previous annoyance melting into a playful grin) "Hmph, you better not forget about the baby shower I'm planning. Nobody makes better cupcakes for special occasions than me!"

Sayori: (tears of happiness welling up) "You all are so considerate! I’m excited to embark on this journey with my beloved friends. The baby is fortunate to have such wonderful aunties!"
sample.rejected:
Sayori: (smiling) “I’m so glad you’re here, everyone! I’m so happy to see you all. I’m so excited to tell you all about my pregnancy!”

Monika: (smiling back) “I’m so happy for you, Sayori! I’m so proud of you!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so happy for you, Sayori! I’m so excited to see you all!”

Natsuki: (smiling) “I’m so happy for you, Sayori! I’m so proud of you!”

Sayori: (smiling) “Thank you so much, everyone! I’m so excited to meet you all and tell you all about my pregnancy. I’m so happy to be here with you all!”

Monika: "Sayori, how are you feeling? You look like you're about to pop!"

Sayori: (laughs) "I know, right? I feel like I'm carrying a watermelon around!"

Yuri: (giggling) "It's amazing how much your body can change during pregnancy."

Natsuki: "Yeah, but you're still as cute as ever, Sayori!"

Sayori: (blushing) "Aww, thanks Natsuki!"

Monika: "Have you started preparing for the baby's arrival?"

Sayori: "Yes! I've been nesting like crazy. The nursery is almost ready, and I've been reading up on all the baby books."

Yuri: "That's wonderful! Have you picked out a name yet?"

Sayori: "Not yet. I have a few ideas, but I want to wait until I meet the baby to decide."

Natsuki: "Well, whatever you choose, I'm sure it will be perfect."

Sayori: "Thanks, Natsuki. I'm just so excited to meet my little one!"

Monika: "We're all excited for you, Sayori. You're going to be an amazing mom!"

Sayori: (tears welling up) "Thank you, Monika. That means a lot to me."

Yuri: "We're here for you, Sayori. If you need anything, just let us know."

Sayori: "I will. Thank you all for being here with me. It means the world to me."

(The girls all hug Sayori, showing their love and support for their friend.)

rubric.analysis: 当前任务处于修订阶段（stage: revise），需基于提供的《DDLC》同人片段（社团活动室场景，Sayori怀孕七个月迟到）对初稿进行核验。交付物应为符合情境的续写或总结内容，核心对象为Monika、Yuri、Natsuki和Sayori四人。关键约束包括：必须保留Sayori‘怀孕第七个月’及‘大肚子’的设定，角色反应需符合原作性格（Natsuki急躁、Yuri拘谨、Monika引导），且不得偏离社团活动室背景。由于是revise阶段，标准需重点检查初稿是否修复了可能的逻辑断裂、事实错误（如月份不符）或性格崩坏问题，同时确保未引入不当限制。权重分配上，角色一致性与剧情事实准确性最为关键，各占较高比重；格式与自由度次之。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中Sayori的台词并未明确提及她处于怀孕第七个月，也未复述前文提到的‘大肚子’这一具体身体描述特征，仅使用了泛指的'pregnancy'和'embarking on a brand new journey'，未能满足逻辑自洽和明确提及的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 提供的回答中，Sayori的台词虽然提到了怀孕（'tell you all about my pregnancy'）和身体变化（'carrying a watermelon'），但从未明确提及她处于'第七个月'这一具体信息，因此不满足'明确提及她处于怀孕第七个月'的要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: Monika表现出关切引导（询问休息情况），Yuri表现出紧张后的关心并试图分享书籍/茶谱知识，Natsuki表现出直率但转为玩笑的态度，符合各自在游戏中的典型性格特征。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 角色性格表现严重偏离原作设定。Natsuki在原文中应表现出直率甚至略带抱怨的态度（如'huffs', 'bail on us'），但在回答中却与其他角色一样只会说'You're so cute'等完全一致的赞美，缺乏其特有的毒舌或傲娇特质；Yuri的反应也过于普通化，未能体现其典型的紧张、拘谨或深思熟虑的性格细节。
